selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What main truth is seen among the things in the universe in this passage?
questions.answer: A strong pattern of helping and working together is seen among them.

questions.question: What makes the co-operation mentioned here amazing?
questions.answer: It keeps happening during nonstop changes and is greater than the beings’ own ability.

questions.question: How do the basic elements serve living things?
questions.answer: They hurry to help them.

questions.question: What do plants help?
questions.answer: They help animals.

questions.question: What problem would come if someone claimed lifeless things organize this help by themselves?
questions.answer: That would mean unaware things act with understanding and care, which does not fit their nature.

questions.question: What do all these examples teach about the Lord of all the worlds?
questions.answer: They teach that His care is universal and full of compassion.

questions.question: Why can lifeless things not be the real planners of this co-operation?
questions.answer: Because they have no feeling or awareness, yet they act in fitting and careful ways.

questions.question: What does the mention of bees show?
questions.answer: It shows that even small creatures are given duties.

questions.question: Where is beauty or adornment seen according to the passage?
questions.answer: It is seen across the sky, the earth, and flowers.

questions.question: Which small creature is mentioned as having a duty?
questions.answer: The honey-bee.

questions.question: What truth is the passage focusing on in the universe?
questions.answer: It focuses on the truth that created things support one another.

questions.question: What does the passage say about their ability compared to the help we observe?
questions.answer: The observed help is beyond what they could manage on their own.

questions.question: Which things are said to rush to help living creatures?
questions.answer: The elements.

questions.question: What example from inside the body shows organized help?
questions.answer: Food particles are directed to the body’s cells to renew and feed them.

questions.question: How does the body give another sign of co-operation?
questions.answer: Food particles are made to serve the cells of the body.

questions.question: What do these examples together demonstrate?
questions.answer: They demonstrate the all-encompassing and merciful lordship of the Sustainer of all worlds.

questions.question: Where does the passage say adornment or beauty can be seen?
questions.answer: It can be seen in the sky, on the earth, and on flowers.

questions.question: What two qualities are said to be found from planets down to tiny body parts?
questions.answer: Balance and preservation.

questions.question: What does the passage say about order?
questions.answer: It says order rules over everything from giant star systems to small fruits.

questions.question: What do all these truths provide together?
questions.answer: They provide a great testimony.

questions.question: What is one main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: Everything in creation is linked by a pattern of mutual help.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the many changes happening around them?
questions.answer: These changes are always taking place.

questions.question: Which group is said to help living creatures directly?
questions.answer: The basic materials of the world, like the elements, are said to help living creatures.

questions.question: What bigger truth do all these examples point to?
questions.answer: They point to the merciful care and rule of the Lord of all worlds.
